clue.text: Make a show of importing gold from abroad

blocks.note: to feign is to pretend, to make a show of
OR is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Someone flaunts gold they have shipped in from overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: OR as gold comes from heraldry, where the tinctures have French names.
explanation.definitionFit: Something foreign comes from another country, which is exactly what from abroad describes.

clue.text: Was hospital essentially underbuying? A regrettable omission, this bathroom fixture

indicators.note: essentially means at its very heart, so only the central letter of the word is kept

blocks.note: taken as written
H is the standard abbreviation for hospital
the sixth of its eleven letters sits at the exact centre
taken as written

explanation.surface: A hospital administrator's failure to buy enough supplies is lamented.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's question mark and 'A' look like they belong together, but A is a separate piece before SIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A washbasin is the sink in a bathroom, a plumbed-in fitting for washing hands.

clue.text: Hot food that's cold when delivered?

blocks.note: chilly means cold, and sounds identical to the spice

explanation.surface: A takeaway meal that is hot when ordered arrives stone cold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Delivered' suggests a takeaway order, but here it means spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: Chilli is a fiery pepper, or a spicy stew made with it, so hot in the spicy sense.

clue.text: Dance along with Come Together on the radio or scoff?

a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A Beatles song played on the radio prompts a dance or a sneer.
explanation.walkthrough: Come Together is a Beatles song, which hides the plain verb meet. Scoff here is British slang for food, not a sneer.
explanation.definitionFit: Scoff is informal British slang for food, and a meatball is a piece of food.

clue.text: Wrong interpretation of flawed instructions company centrally implemented

blocks.note: taken as written
CO is the abbreviation for company
the sixth of eleven letters is the centre

explanation.surface: A firm misreads faulty instructions when putting them into practice.
explanation.definitionFit: To misconstrue is to misunderstand, so a misconstruction is a mistaken reading of meaning.

clue.text: Familiarise a Conservative with whimsical following

C is the abbreviation for Conservative
quaint means oddly charming or whimsical

explanation.surface: A party member gets to know an eccentric group of supporters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Following' looks like a noun for a body of supporters, but it just places the whimsical word after A and C.
explanation.definitionFit: To acquaint someone with something is to make them familiar with it.

clue.text: Censor part of unacceptable episode

blocks.note: the letters run across the join of the two words

explanation.surface: A broadcaster cuts a section from an offensive TV episode.
explanation.definitionFit: To bleep is to censor a swear word on air by covering it with a tone.

clue.text: Give permission for adjusted scene to replace ending of story

the new letters take the place of the final letter of the following word

blocks.note: a lie is a made-up story
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged SCENE becomes CENSE and replaces the final E of LIE, leaving LI + CENSE.
explanation.definitionFit: To license something is to authorise it formally, granting permission for it.

clue.text: Fertiliser mixed at shop

indicators.note: mixed means jumbled together, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Garden feed is blended on the premises at the store.
explanation.definitionFit: Potash is a potassium compound widely spread on soil as a plant nutrient.

clue.text: Second Queen sorted out church order of succession

indicators.note: sorted out means arranged afresh, so the letters are put in a new order

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for second
taken as written
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A second queen settles the church's line of royal inheritance.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads order of succession as royal inheritance; it simply means things following one another.
explanation.definitionFit: A sequence is a series of things coming one after another in a fixed order.

clue.text: Developing pharmaceutical to isolate catastrophic trauma of the head

indicators.note: something developing is changing its form, so the letters are rearranged
isolating something sets it apart, so those letters are taken away from the rest
catastrophic means ruinous, so the letters to remove appear in jumbled order

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written; its letters are scattered through the longer word

explanation.surface: A new drug is being developed to treat severe head injuries.
explanation.walkthrough: Strike the letters T, R, A, U, M, A from PHARMACEUTICAL, then rearrange the eight that remain.
explanation.definitionFit: Cephalic is the medical adjective relating to the head, from the Greek for head.

clue.text: Add a very soft concluding passage

blocks.note: taken as written
pp, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very soft
the end is the closing part

explanation.surface: A composer tacks on a quiet coda.
explanation.definitionFit: To append is to attach something extra at the end, which is to add it.

clue.text: Farm husked grain supply on area of land

read as the adverb of supple, it means bendily, so the letters are twisted into a new order

blocks.note: the word without its outside letters
taken as written
A is the abbreviation for area

explanation.surface: A farm supplies husked grain grown on a patch of land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supply' looks like a noun meaning provision, but it is the adverb from supple, as in bendily. 'Farm' looks like part of the definition, but only its middle is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Agrarian means relating to the cultivation and ownership of land.

clue.text: Musical artist's offspring primarily giving sway to elevated recitals

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so only the opening letter of each following word is kept

blocks.note: a son is a male offspring
the opening letters of these five words

explanation.surface: A singer's child gives way to grand performances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Musical artist's' reads as possessive, but the 's is 'is', linking definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A songster is a singer, a performer of songs, so a kind of musical artist.

clue.text: Method of signalling unusual atmosphere when short of time

indicators.note: unusual means out of the ordinary, so the letters are put in an unexpected order
short of means lacking, so the following letter is taken away

blocks.note: taken as written
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Signals are sent in an odd atmosphere with little time to spare.
explanation.definitionFit: Semaphore is a system of signalling with flags held in different positions.

clue.text: Clash with fool over the closure of welfare programs

indicators.note: the closure is where something ends, so only the final letter is kept

blocks.note: a soft is an informal word for a simpleton
a war is a clash between sides
its final letter

explanation.surface: Opponents fight over shutting down welfare schemes.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'with fool over' puts SOFT above WAR; 'programs' is computer programs, not welfare schemes.
explanation.definitionFit: Software is the collective name for the programs a computer runs.

clue.text: Old writer cross over unrestricted immigration

indicators.note: turned over means flipped end to end, so the word is read backwards

blocks.note: O is the abbreviation for old
a pen is a writing instrument
a rood is a cross or crucifix

explanation.surface: A veteran author is angry about lax border policy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like the adjective angry, but it is the noun rood, a crucifix.
explanation.definitionFit: An open-door policy lets people in freely, as with immigration without restriction.

clue.text: Proportionately favouring a sailor on the rise

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means reading upwards, so the word runs backwards

blocks.note: pro means in favour of
taken as written
a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A fair share goes to a sailor who is being promoted.
explanation.walkthrough: Only 'a sailor' is turned round; 'favouring' stays as it is at the top.
explanation.definitionFit: Pro rata is Latin for in proportion, as when a payment is scaled to hours worked.

clue.text: Casual stupid person absorbed by computer connectivity test

clue.text: Well-informed remedy involving a very violent disruption

indicators.note: to involve is to include within, so the following letters go inside

blocks.note: to be up on a subject is to be well-informed about it
to heal is to cure, to remedy
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Very' looks like it modifies violent in the surface, but it is a separate abbreviation inside the remedy.
explanation.definitionFit: An upheaval is a sudden, forceful upset or overturning of things.

clue.text: Female accepting fuss involving direct confrontation

blocks.note: a hen is a female bird
ado is fuss or bother

clue.text: Fail to think of furnace temperature

explanation.definitionFit: To forget something is to not remember it, to let it slip the mind.

clue.text: Ultimately daring adult to take part in game in which players have to pick up manure

indicators.note: ultimately means in the end, so only the last letter is kept
taking part in something means going into it, so a letter is put inside

blocks.note: its final letter

clue.text: Instructs arboriculturist conclusively where to store leaves

its final letter

taken as written

clue.text: A function in prison of the 17th century

taken as written
